reason: The second and final allowed image attempt produced a strong mobile direction, but one evidence-form row still places Amount and Accounting month side by side instead of making every input full width, and the rendered UI does not literally state the requested no-self-approval rule. The image-call budget is exhausted, so the remaining review findings are retained rather than hidden.

outputs.description: Exact prompt submitted for the retained second image-generation attempt.

outputs.text: Attempt 1 preserved the baseline content and converted the desktop table into mobile document cards, but left the four lower action areas in two side-by-side columns. Attempt 2 kept the original baseline attached, used attempt 1 only as an additional rejected-candidate reference, and stacked every major panel vertically. The retained image is materially closer to a 390 CSS-pixel layout and preserves the immutable-ledger, pending-correction, document-state, reconciliation, close-period, audit, context, and setup concepts. It remains a design artifact; native controls, authorization, and live data require implementation. No response record was written for attempt 1.

observations.note: Major panels are vertically stacked and the desktop table is gone, but Amount and Accounting month still share one row rather than using the requested full-width-input treatment.
The pixels show Immutable snapshot (view-only), a lock, Ledger v7, as-of date, ledger-version input, current immutable balance, and current/as-of controls without an edit-history affordance.
The pixels show the Draft, Submitted, Approved, and Posted filters and preserve the three supplied records as readable stacked cards with statuses and source facts.
All requested actions and the pending-zero-effect message are visible, but the requested explicit no-self-approval wording is absent; distinct approval is stated only for the pending proposal.
The result retains the baseline's white cards, thin gray borders, compact sans-serif type, dark navy actions, green success badges, blue submitted badge, amber pending accent, and restrained density.
